#en: Shields down.
zh: 护盾失效。

#en: Warning: Defensive systems failing.
zh: 警告：防御系统即将失效。

#en: Critical alert: Shields down.
zh: 严重警报：护盾失效。

#en: Shield systems compromised.
zh: 护盾系统受损。

#en: Primary shields depleted.
zh: 主护盾已耗尽。

#en: Warning: Shield failure.
zh: 警告：护盾故障。

#en: Shield loss detected.
zh: 检测到护盾损失。

#en: Defensive barriers down.
zh: 防御屏障失效。

#en: Shields offline.
zh: 护盾离线。

#en: Warning: Shield integrity compromised.
zh: 警告：护盾完整性受损。

#en: One last thing. You spoken to Harper yet? If not, you should poke your head in and say hello!
zh: 还有最后一件事。你跟哈珀谈过了吗？如果还没有，你该去露个面打个招呼！

#en: One last thing. You spoken to Gren yet? If not, you should poke your head in and say hello!
zh: 还有最后一件事。你跟格伦谈过了吗？如果还没有，你该去露个面打个招呼！

#en: ...Hah. Hahaha, you sly dog! Man, you're one good actor, I had no idea! I'm glad you didn't reveal anything, that was almost certainly for the best. Hah! Well done.
zh: ……哈。哈哈哈，你这滑头！天呐，你可真会演戏，我完全没看出来！幸好你没说漏什么，那多半是最好的做法。哈！干得好。

#en: One last thing. You spoken to Harper and Gren yet? If not, you should poke your head in and say hello!
zh: 还有最后一件事。你跟哈珀和格伦谈过了吗？如果还没有，你该去露个面打个招呼！

#en: There's still a lot to see out there, and I sure am looking forward to seeing it.
zh: 外面还有很多值得一看的东西，而我真的很期待去看看。

#en: Okay, yeah, I think that's all I needed to say. So, let's get back to it!
zh: 好，嗯，我想我想说的都说完了。那咱们继续干吧！

#en: Sorry, no. I think I'd rather we go our separate ways.
zh: 抱歉，不行。我想我们还是各走各的路吧。

#en: You don't need to be a hero, Torin. That's my job.
zh: 你不用去当英雄，托林。那是我的活儿。

#en: No, not yet.
zh: 不，还没有。

#en: *laugh*... You really are something else.
zh: *笑*……你可真是与众不同。

#en: And also, show Gren that Mainframe slate. Fairly sure there's something on there he'd find useful.
zh: 还有，把主机那块数据板给格伦看看。我挺肯定上面有他会觉得有用的东西。

#en: Don't know for sure, but I think it might be filled with Computer Cores! And maybe some other stuff too.
zh: 不确定，但我觉得里面可能装满了计算机核心！也许还有些别的东西。

#en: Anyway, do me a favor? Play along, alright? Pretend it really is the "first time". Trust me, it's just easier that way! For all concerned.
zh: 总之，帮我个忙好吗？配合一下，行吗？就当真的是"第一次"。相信我，那样对大家都更省事！

#en: It'll be like we've met for the first time. Well, second time, for him. Ah, you know what I mean...
zh: 就像我们是初次见面一样。嗯，对他来说是第二次。唉，你懂我的意思……

#en: Say, before you get going, if you do pass through The Unity, find yourself in a new universe -- if you were to meet me again, that Torin won't know anything...
zh: 对了，在你出发前，如果你真的穿过"归一"、到了一个新宇宙——要是你再遇见我，那个托林什么都不会知道……

#en: I think it's best we just play it safe. We know this way works! No reason to mess with success.
zh: 我觉得还是稳妥点好。我们知道这样做行得通！没必要去动已经成功的东西。

#en: It'll increase the chance of divergence! Of things playing out differently than they did this time. And with that comes unforeseen risks...
zh: 那会增加出现分歧的几率！让事情的发展与这次不同。而随之而来的，是无法预见的风险……

#en: Assuming Watchtower is still a problem, if you reveal we've done all this before to a Torin who wasn't a part of that, it'll change things.
zh: 假设瞭望塔仍是个麻烦，如果你向一个不曾参与这一切的托林透露我们做过这些事，事情就会改变。

#en: I do! It's best for me, and it's best for you. Trust me, I've tried breaking that rule before and it... Well, let's just say, it didn't go well. Anyway...
zh: 我认为该！这对我最好，对你也是。相信我，我以前试过打破那条规则，结果……这么说吧，并不顺利。总之……

#en: Since you mention it, we HAVE done this before. I just didn't tell you...
zh: 既然你提起了，我们确实做过这些。只是我没告诉你……

#en: Why would I have to pretend?
zh: 我为什么要装？

#en: If you think that's for the best.
zh: 如果你认为那样最好。

#en: Get a leg up on Watchtower from the beginning! Hah. If you travel to a new universe, that is.
zh: 从一开头就领先瞭望塔一步！哈。前提是你要去一个新宇宙。

#en: And, added bonus! If you commit the location and access codes to memory, no reason you couldn't plunder the storehouse after a Unity jump!
zh: 而且还有额外好处！只要你把位置和通行密码记牢，归一之后照样可以去洗劫那座仓库！

#en: But really, that's a decision for you to make. So, assuming I can travel to the same universe as you... do you want me to?
zh: 但说到底，这该由你来决定。那么，假设我能和你去同一个宇宙……你希望我去吗？

#en: I don't know if that's true! But, I think I'd be okay with that. I think I would like to go with you.
zh: 我不知道那是不是真的！但我想我可以接受。我想和你一起去。

#en: The part of you I spoke to, it said if you were to pass through Unity, to travel on to another universe, that I could go with you now if I wanted.
zh: 我与之交谈的"你"的那部分说，如果你穿过归一、前往另一个宇宙，只要我愿意，现在就可以和你一起去。

#en: Anyway, I don't know about you, but I definitely feel... something between us that wasn't there before.
zh: 总之，我不知道你怎么想，但我确实感觉到……我们之间多了些以前没有的东西。

#en: Okay, good advice.
zh: 好，这建议不错。

#en: What is this frequency, how will it work?
zh: 这个频率是什么，怎么运作？

#en: Anyway, I think you should check it out. Would make a nice opportunity for some plundering! Stock up on some more Watchtower tech.
zh: 总之，我觉得你该去看看。那是个不错的劫掠机会！多屯点瞭望塔科技。

#en: Anyway, if you've not already done so, you should check it out! Stock up on some of the Watchtower tech stored in there.
zh: 总之，如果你还没去过，就该去看看！把存放在那里的瞭望塔科技搜刮一些。

#en: Well, you should! One of the things on there -- is the location and access codes for a Watchtower storehouse.
zh: 你该去！那上面有一项东西——是瞭望塔一座仓库的位置和通行密码。

#en: Yeah, I gave it a look.
zh: 嗯，我看过了。

#en: That slate I gave you, the one with data from the Watchtower Mainframe. Have you had a chance to look at it yet?
zh: 我给你的那块数据板，就是存有瞭望塔主机数据的那块。你有机会看过吗？

#en: I'll be monitoring Watchtower comms, so if you send that signal, I'll know exactly where you are, and I'll be sure to get to you as quickly as I can!
zh: 我会监听瞭望塔的通信，所以只要你发出那个信号，我就能确切知道你在哪，并尽快赶到你身边！

#en: There! I transferred data for a signal frequency. Aim a comm broadcast on that frequency at any Watchtower ship's transmitter array.
zh: 好了！我传输了一个信号频率的数据。把该频率的通信广播对准任意瞭望塔舰船的发射阵列即可。

#en: I'll think about it. No promises.
zh: 我会考虑。不保证。

#en: If we don't meet right away, what will you do?
zh: 如果我们没能马上碰面，你打算怎么办？

#en: Alright! If you happen to enter The Unity again, find yourself on the road to another universe, you now got yourself a travel buddy!
zh: 好！如果你再进入归一、踏上通往另一个宇宙的路，你现在就有个旅伴了！

#en: Heh. Alright! If you ever do step into The Unity, find yourself on the road to another universe, you now got yourself a travel buddy!
zh: 嘿。好！你要是真踏入归一、踏上通往另一个宇宙的路，你现在就有个旅伴了！

#en: Okay then, moving on...
zh: 那好，继续……

#en: Oh, and you'll have to memorize that frequency, because when you hop universes, you can't take the data with you.
zh: 哦，还有，你得把那个频率记牢，因为跨宇宙跳跃时，数据是带不走的。

#en: But plenty of people have found creative workarounds, including Watchtower. So, we just borrow their hardware to send a message!
zh: 但很多人都想出了有创意的变通办法，瞭望塔也是。所以我们就借用他们的硬件来发讯息！

#en: Think of it as a "deep space ping". As I'm sure you know, communications between systems can be tricky.
zh: 你可以把它想成一次"深空信号探测"。你肯定知道，星系之间的通信有时很棘手。

#en: I'll be sure to do that.
zh: 我一定会这么做。

#en: I think I know what you mean.
zh: 我想我明白你的意思。

#en: You know, meet Harper, repair Stardock, save Gren... Oh! And I can get my old ship back! Wonder how long I'll be able to keep it next time...?
zh: 你知道的，见哈珀、修复星坞、救格伦……哦！还能找回我的老飞船！不知道下次我能保住它多久……？

#en: If I arrive before you, I guess I'll just... start getting stuff ready!
zh: 如果我比你先到，我想我就……先开始做准备吧！

#en: But why my choice, and not yours?
zh: 但为什么是由我选择，而不是你？

#en: This is your show, not mine. Besides, something tells me you may be moving on to more important things in the future. So, if I can, I'd like to help with that.
zh: 这是你的舞台，不是我的。再说，我有种感觉，将来你可能会去做更重要的事。所以，如果可以，我想帮上忙。

#en: Ah, good! Did you see one of the things on there? The location and access codes for a Watchtower storehouse?
zh: 啊，好！你看到上面的一项东西了吗？瞭望塔一座仓库的位置和通行密码？

#en: ...Moving on!
zh: ……继续！

#en: Hey, that is absolutely fine. Really! I can completely understand how having a tagalong could complicate a lot of things, so, no hard feelings.
zh: 嘿，完全没问题。真的！我完全能理解带着个跟屁虫会让很多事变复杂，所以，别往心里去。

#en: Thanks for talking me out of it! That's twice you've saved my life now! Hah, so much for me making things even!
zh: 谢谢你劝住我！这已经是你第二次救我的命了！哈，看来我是没法还清人情了！

#en: *sigh* But I was trying so hard to play the part of the hero, I didn't stop to think there might be another way.
zh: *叹气*但我太想扮演英雄的角色了，都没停下来想想也许还有别的办法。

#en: I was ready to do it, you know? To stay on Heimdall Station as it blew up.
zh: 我本来准备好那么做了，你知道吗？留在海姆达尔站里，看着它爆炸。

#en: And maybe because we're Starborn, or perhaps because of where we were, or how we got there...
zh: 也许是因为我们是星裔，也许是因为我们所在的地方，或者我们抵达那里的方式……

#en: And maybe because I'm Starborn, or perhaps because of where we were, or how we got there...
zh: 也许因为我是星裔，也许是因为我们所在的地方，或者我们抵达那里的方式……

#en: After that, I'm fairly sure it would become a permanent arrangement. Which is why I think you need to be the one to make the choice on this...
zh: 在那之后，我相当肯定这就会变成一种永久的安排。所以我觉得这件事该由你来做决定……

#en: The way it was worded, it seemed like I had a choice in the matter. At least, for the first time.
zh: 从措辞来看，似乎在这个问题上我有选择。至少，这是第一次。

#en: But, I guess... If you were to pass through The Unity, I'd figuratively or literally get pulled along with you!
zh: 但我猜……如果你穿过归一，我大概会以某种方式被一起带过去！

#en: Phew, you're asking big questions that I do not have the answers to.
zh: 呼，你问的是我没有答案的大问题。

#en: How would that work? How would you travel with me to another universe?
zh: 那要怎么实现？你怎么和我一起去另一个宇宙？

#en: Yes, I'd be happy if you could join me.
zh: 好，如果你能和我一起，我会很高兴。

#en: I'm not sure I'd go that far...
zh: 我倒不确定会到那一步……

#en: But, I'll do my best to find you. And if Watchtower tracks you before I do, hang on, just need to send you something...
zh: 但我会尽力找到你。如果瞭望塔先我一步追踪到你，撑住，我得给你传点东西……

#en: Although, no idea how that'll play out. Somehow, I doubt I'll just appear next to you. Hah. That would just be too easy!
zh: 不过，也不知道那会如何发展。不知怎的，我怀疑我不会直接出现在你身边。哈。那也太容易了！

#en: But, like I said, it'll be up to you.
zh: 但就像我说的，这取决于你。

#en: Well, sure! It's a dangerous universe out there. There's more than just Watchtower to keep an eye out for.
zh: 那是当然！外面的宇宙很危险。要留神的可不只有瞭望塔。

#en: So you don't think Watchtower will be a problem now?
zh: 所以你认为瞭望塔现在不成问题了？

#en: Still! An interesting experience! Now, moving on...
zh: 不过！这仍是段有趣的经历！好，继续……

#en: It presented us with the chance to... form a deeper understanding! Although, I don't think anything really came from it...
zh: 它给了我们一个机会……去形成更深的了解！虽说我觉得也没真得出什么结果……

#en: It allowed us to... form a deeper understanding! And because of that, we now have this connection between us, this "bond"... Does that make sense...?
zh: 它让我们……形成了更深的了解！正因如此，我们之间如今有了这种联系，这种"羁绊"……这样说能理解吗……？

#en: Not a conscious part, more like... a spirit! A representation of our thoughts and feelings.
zh: 不是有意识的部分，更像是……一种灵！是我们思想和感情的化身。

#en: Well, not so much a theory, as a hazy notion, but, here goes... Those "people" we spoke to, I think we were both talking to a part of each other...
zh: 嗯，与其说是理论，不如说是模糊的猜想，不过，我就说了……我们交谈的那些"人"，我觉得我们其实都是在与对方的一部分交谈……

#en: Speaking of things on the mind, that whole "bonding" thing? I've been thinking about that... And I've got a theory...
zh: 说到心里的事，那个"羁绊"的事？我一直在想……而我有个理论……

#en: Without the station, even if they did capture us, we'd likely just be able to escape! So for now, I think we're good and safe.
zh: 没了那座空间站，就算他们抓到我们，我们多半也能逃掉！所以眼下，我觉得我们没事，很安全。

#en: As far as we know, Heimdall Station was the only place they could contain Starborn for extended periods.
zh: 据我们所知，海姆达尔站是他们唯一能长期关押星裔的地方。

#en: Not to the extent that they were, no. At least not for a long, long time.
zh: 不会像以前那样了，不会。至少很长时间内都不会。

#en: Well, aren't we boastful? Not that I disagree...
zh: 哟，我们还挺自信？不过我并不反对……

#en: From my perspective? No, not really.
zh: 从我的角度看？不，不太会。

#en: You think I'll still need a fleet?
zh: 你觉得我还需要舰队吗？

#en: Okay, I'll be sure to keep all that in mind.
zh: 好，我会把这些都记在心里。

#en: If you wanna keep your fleet going, I'd say that's up to you! I mean, would still be useful! Just less of a necessity now.
zh: 如果你想继续维持舰队，那由你决定！我是说，它仍然有用！只是现在没那么必要了。

#en: I'm sure we'll still encounter the odd patrol or group of operatives, but as far as them being able to capture us? I do believe that ship has sailed.
zh: 我们肯定还会遇到零星的巡逻队或特工小队，但至于他们能不能抓到我们？我相信那已经不可能了。

#en: Now, after how badly we busted them up, I don't think we'll need to worry about Watchtower anymore. At least, not in any serious way.
zh: 如今，在我们把他们打得那么惨之后，我觉得不用再担心瞭望塔了。至少，不会是什么大威胁。

#en: Oh, well! That makes me feel much better... *chuckle*...
zh: 哦，好吧！这让我感觉好多了……*轻笑*……

#en: Don't worry, I'm keeping a running tab.
zh: 别担心，我一直给你记着账呢。

#en: Hehe! Yeah, well, that makes two of us...
zh: 嘿嘿！是啊，那咱们俩都一样……

#en: I'm just glad you'll be able to stick around.
zh: 我很高兴你能留下来。

#en: Anyway, I should get back to work. But, again, glad you came back in mostly one piece.
zh: 总之，我该回去干活了。不过再说一次，很高兴你基本完好地回来了。

#en: If you plan to keep hunting Listening Posts, just know it may not be Watchtower that show up to investigate what you're up to.
zh: 如果你打算继续猎杀监听哨，要知道，前来调查你在干什么的未必是瞭望塔。

#en: Guess Watchtower are too preoccupied to enforce secrecy like they used to...
zh: 看来瞭望塔现在分身乏术，没法像以前那样严密封锁消息了……

#en: Already, other factions out there have begun to find and uncover their hidden assets.
zh: 其他势力已经开始发现并揭出他们隐藏的资产了。

#en: I should tell you! I've been hearing from my contacts that Watchtower's fall hasn't gone unnoticed...
zh: 我该告诉你！我的线人一直跟我说，瞭望塔的倒台并没有被忽视……

#en: I just wanted to check in, see how everything is.
zh: 我只是想来确认一下，看看一切如何。

#en: Oh, sure. Since you mention it...
zh: 哦，当然。既然你提起了……

#en: Thanks, I appreciate your concern.
zh: 谢谢，感谢你的关心。

#en: Yeah, well. Really is the least I could do...
zh: 是啊。这真的是我至少能做的……

#en: I've already lost more than enough friends, I didn't want to have to add you and Torin to that list!
zh: 我失去的朋友已经够多了，我不想再把你和托林加进那个名单！

#en: *sigh* It is so good to see you're safe! I was worried...
zh: *叹气*看到你平安真好！我很担心……

#en: I'm sorry, I know I brought him up, but I don't think I'm ready to talk about Torin right now. But I am glad that you're still here.
zh: 抱歉，是我先提起他的，但我想我现在还不想谈托林的事。不过我很高兴你还在这里。

#en: But I know he'd have died doing what he thought was right, so...
zh: 但我知道他是为做了自己认为正确的事而死的，所以……

#en: Gren told me about Torin... I... I don't think I've really had time to process it yet.
zh: 格伦跟我说了托林的事……我……我觉得我还没真正有时间去消化。

#en: Oh, hey! Good to see you're safe. I was worried about you...
zh: 哦，嘿！看到你平安真好。我很担心你……

#en: I will take no more of your time. I'm glad you survived your encounter with Watchtower. Until we speak again.
zh: 我不再占用你的时间了。很高兴你在与瞭望塔的交锋中活了下来。下次再谈。

#en: We may be able to fabricate these Skydrops. But I will require more data for this. If you can bring me enough Computer Cores, I will see what I can do.
zh: 我们也许能制造这些空投。但为此我需要更多数据。如果你能给我带来足够多的计算机核心，我会看看能做些什么。

#en: Intriguing. There are new designs for Skydrops on here. They seem to be based around some kind of... "Deviant" technology.
zh: 有意思。这上面有空投的新设计。它们似乎基于某种……"异常体"技术。

#en: I'm just glad I'll be left alone.
zh: 我只庆幸自己能不被打扰。

#en: I can understand your feelings in this.
zh: 我理解你在这件事上的感受。

#en: Hm. I thought he might. Allow me just a moment, and I'll see what he was able to extract...
zh: 嗯。我猜他会。给我一点时间，我来看看他能提取出什么……

#en: [Hand slate] Yes, he did. Take a look.
zh: [递上数据板]是的，他提取了。你看看吧。

#en: Before you take your leave, I wanted to ask, did Torin try to extract any information from the Watchtower Mainframe?
zh: 在你离开之前，我想问一句，托林有没有尝试从瞭望塔主机中提取信息？

#en: Maintain vigilance, and I am sure you will be fine.
zh: 保持警惕，我相信你会没事的。

#en: From now on, I suspect you'll see a lot less Watchtower activity. But do not think that they are gone completely. There will still be Operatives out there.
zh: 从现在起，我猜你会看到瞭望塔的活动大大减少。但别以为他们已彻底消失。外面仍会有特工。

#en: What will Watchtower do now?
zh: 瞭望塔现在会怎么做？

#en: Thanks for all your help, Gren.
zh: 谢谢你的所有帮助，格伦。

#en: It is not uncommon for Watchtower cells to operate in the dark. Years may pass before some even begin to suspect something went awry.
zh: 瞭望塔的各个小组在暗中行动并不罕见。有些小组可能要过好几年才会开始怀疑出了岔子。

#en: Those members who know what has happened, will focus on rebuilding. But this will take time. Those who don't know, will continue on as normal.
zh: 那些知道发生了什么的成员会专注于重建。但这需要时间。而那些不知情的人，则会照常行事。

#en: Do you think I'm safe from Watchtower now?
zh: 你觉得我现在安全，不会被瞭望塔找上了吗？

#en: It was my pleasure to assist.
zh: 能帮上忙是我的荣幸。

#en: For the most part, yes. Watchtower is not gone, but it is weakened. For the time being, they will have more important things to attend to.
zh: 大体上是。瞭望塔没有消失，但已被削弱。眼下，他们会有更重要的事要处理。

#en: Not that I blame you. But he was a good person, and a good friend. I shall miss him.
zh: 我不是怪你。但他是个好人，也是个好朋友。我会想念他。

#en: It's just a shame that Torin had to die in order to achieve this.
zh: 只可惜为了达成这一切，托林不得不牺牲。

#en: I believe it is a safe assumption -- that you no longer have to worry about Watchtower attempting to capture you.
zh: 我相信这可以放心地认为——你不必再担心瞭望塔试图抓你了。

#en: I wanted to congratulate you. I don't think Watchtower has ever been dealt such a crippling blow. It'll take them a long time to recover from this.
zh: 我想向你道贺。瞭望塔恐怕从未遭受过如此沉重的打击。他们要恢复过来需要很长时间。

#en: Ah, there you are.
zh: 啊，你在这儿。

#en: Hey, knock that off!
zh: 嘿，别闹了！

#en: Are you trying to get in the way?
zh: 你是想挡道吗？

#en: Seriously, give me some space here!
zh: 说真的，给我留点空间！

#en: Yeah... Yeah, Gren, we know. They must be launching them from the station. It's probably right above us!
zh: 是啊……是啊，格伦，我们知道。它们一定是从空间站发射的。多半就在我们头顶！

#en: You should grab that care package!
zh: 你该去拿那个补给包！

#en: We're not "plotting", we're... organizing! You make it sound so sinister...
zh: 我们不是"密谋"，我们是……在组织安排！你说得好像多险恶似的……

#en: There! That must be the cloak's power plant. Touch down, and we'll make our way to it.
zh: 那儿！那一定就是隐形装置的动力站。着陆，我们过去。

#en: *sigh* Didn't think I'd ever be coming back to this place... I wonder if Watchtower knows we're here.
zh: *叹气*没想到我还会再回到这个地方……不知道瞭望塔是否知道我们在这儿。

#en: Right, let's scan the planet and find the power plant.
zh: 好，我们扫描这颗行星，找到发电厂。

#en: They've got troops on the ground! Shouldn't be surprised... We'll have to take them out!
zh: 他们在地面上有部队！不该意外……我们得把他们解决掉！

#en: I-- Oh. I should not have said that...
zh: 我——哦。我不该那么说的……

#en: Hah! That wasn't so tough! Considering how important this thing is, I would've expected more security.
zh: 哈！也没那么难嘛！考虑到这东西这么重要，我还以为守卫会更多。

#en: Argh... Get ready! I have a feeling the real fight's about to begin!
zh: 呃……做好准备！我感觉真正的战斗就要开始了！

#en: Ooooh, come on!! That's just overkill!
zh: 哦哦，拜托！！这也太夸张了！

#en: I'd suggest using some Skydrops of our own!
zh: 我建议我们也用点空投！

#en: Got anything in the fleet that'll do the job?!
zh: 舰队里有什么能派上用场的吗？！

#en: Hey, Gren? How are we looking up there? Any more incoming surprises?
zh: 嘿，格伦？上面情况怎么样？还有更多惊喜要来吗？

#en: Ah... Okay! Good job. That was... Well, it was something!
zh: 啊……好！干得不错。那真是……嗯，真是够呛！

#en: What in the...
zh: 这是……什么鬼——

#en: I think we might be in trouble...
zh: 我觉得我们可能有麻烦了……

#en: But it's wrong somehow. It's different. It doesn't feel... it doesn't feel natural!
zh: 但总觉得不对劲。它不一样。感觉……感觉不自然！

#en: That's a... that's an Armillary?! It is! I can... I can feel it!
zh: 那是……那是座浑天仪？！没错！我能……我能感觉到！

#en: The Armillary, it's bringing back the dead! Resurrecting the troops we already killed. It's... Only Starborn should be able to do something like this...
zh: 那座浑天仪，它在让死者复活！把我们杀掉的那支部队又复活了。这……只有星裔才该有本事做到这种事……

#en: It's no good! It doesn't matter how many we kill, the Armillary just keeps bringing them back! We need to put that thing outta commission!
zh: 这样不行！不管我们杀掉多少，浑天仪都会把他们带回来！我们得让那东西停摆！

#en: We need to damage that Armillary, stop it doing... whatever it's doing!
zh: 我们得打坏那座浑天仪，让它停下……它正在做的事！

#en: This won't end until the Armillary's taken care of!
zh: 不解决浑天仪，这事就没完！

#en: The Armillary, focus your fire on the Armillary!
zh: 浑天仪，把火力集中在浑天仪上！

#en: That did it! Brace yourself!
zh: 成功了！做好准备！

#en: Yeah! How'd you know?
zh: 是啊！你怎么知道的？

#en: Okay, break time over. Let's get up there!
zh: 好，休息时间结束了。我们上去吧！

#en: ...What's it doing now?! Ugh, well that's not good. Keep away from the Armillary! Don't get too close to it!
zh: ……它现在又在干什么？！呃，这可不太妙。离浑天仪远点！别靠太近！

#en: They're sending down troops in Skydrops! If this keeps up we'll be overwhelmed!
zh: 他们用空投在投放部队！这样下去我们会招架不住！

#en: Shooting it isn't working anymore! Use a Skydrop!!
zh: 开枪已经不管用了！用空投！！

#en: Well, nothing else for it. If we wanna board that station without being blown to pieces, we're gonna have to fight them. Let's do it!
zh: 好吧，没别的办法了。想不被炸成碎片就登上那座空间站，我们就得跟他们打一场。上吧！

#en: That's a lot of ships. Was kinda hoping Gren was exaggerating, should've known better...
zh: 那飞船可真不少。我还指望格伦是在夸张，我早该知道的……

#en: Looks like the station has turrets! We'll have to take those out as well! We won't be able to dock otherwise.
zh: 看来空间站有炮塔！我们也得把它们干掉！否则没法对接。

#en: That's all the station turrets, nice! But there's still Watchtower ships we need to take out.
zh: 空间站的炮塔都清掉了，不错！但还有瞭望塔的飞船要解决。

#en: Look at you, a regular combat pilot! That was the last Watchtower ship, but we still need to take out the station's turrets.
zh: 看看你，简直是战斗飞行员了！那是最后一艘瞭望塔飞船，但我们还得干掉空间站的炮塔。

#en: We need that Armillary active. Maybe try using one of your Starborn abilities on it?
zh: 我们需要那座浑天仪处于激活状态。也许试着对它用一下你的星裔能力？

#en: Okay! The way's clear. Dock with Heimdall Station. We're almost done with this...
zh: 好！路清出来了。与海姆达尔站对接。这事快结束了……

#en: Oh, actually, maybe I shouldn't brag... Otherwise the universe might be tempted to humble me with another Watchtower fleet...
zh: 哦，其实我可能不该自夸……不然宇宙说不定会再派一支瞭望塔舰队来让我谦虚一下……

#en: Haha! Yeah, not so high and mighty now, are you, Watchtower?! Hahaha...
zh: 哈哈！是啊，现在没这么威风了吧，瞭望塔？！哈哈哈……

#en: This way! Should get us to your ship faster.
zh: 这边！能更快到你的飞船。

#en: Oh, yeah! That's working, alright... We should run. Real fast!
zh: 哦，对！那确实管用……我们该跑，跑快点！

#en: What?! Then what the hell are we meant to do now?!
zh: 什么？！那我们现在到底该怎么办？！

#en: Have you found what you need?
zh: 你找到你需要的东西了吗？

#en: You need my help?
zh: 你需要我帮忙？

#en: How goes the Core hunt?
zh: 找核心的事进展如何？

#en: Excuse me, I must prepare my ship. I'll meet you in the Pyraas system.
zh: 抱歉，我得去准备我的飞船。我们在派拉斯星系见。

#en: It won't take long to dock with your ship.
zh: 与你的飞船对接不会花太久。

#en: When you're ready to leave here, just board my vessel.
zh: 你准备离开这里时，上我的飞船就行。

#en: Don't forget, we need to speak with Gren.
zh: 别忘了，我们得和格伦谈谈。

#en: Heimdall Station is the place to be! Let's get going.
zh: 海姆达尔站才是正地儿！我们走吧。

#en: C'mon. Let's shut down that power plant.
zh: 来吧。我们去关掉那座发电厂。

#en: Just need to disable the power flow from the plant. Shouldn't be too difficult to figure out...
zh: 只要切断发电厂的电力输出就行。应该不难搞清楚……

#en: What are you waiting for? Heimdall Station is vulnerable. We need to strike now!
zh: 你还在等什么？海姆达尔站现在正是软肋。我们得立刻动手！

#en: Need to figure out how to get deeper into the station, find this Mainframe Gren talked about.
zh: 得想办法深入空间站，找到格伦说的那个主机。

#en: C'mon, already! Damn Mainframe... It's like it doesn't even care that a Starborn's poking around inside of it...
zh: 快点啊！该死的主机……它好像根本不在乎有个星裔在它里面翻来翻去……

#en: Get out of here! You're running out of time.
zh: 快离开这里！你没时间了。

#en: Activate the Armillary! We've got a station to destroy.
zh: 激活浑天仪！我们还有一座空间站要摧毁。

#en: No time for talk. Get in the Skydrop!
zh: 没时间说话了。上空投！

#en: It's your only chance. Go!
zh: 这是你唯一的机会。快走！

#en: Hey, crazy question, but... Can we use this Armillary to destroy the station?
zh: 嘿，问个疯狂的问题……我们能用这座浑天仪摧毁空间站吗？

#en: WARNING. ANOMALOUS ENERGY SURGE DETECTED. STATION STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY COMPROMISED.
zh: 警告。检测到异常能量激增。空间站结构完整性受损。

#en: Yeah... There's something very familiar about you. We've definitely met before!
zh: 是啊……你身上有种非常熟悉的感觉。我们肯定见过！

#en: I don't suppose you have any idea?
zh: 我猜你也不知道？

#en: I'm not sure where I am, or why I'm here.
zh: 我不确定自己在哪，也不知道为什么在这里。

#en: I'm sorry, I don't think we've met. Not really...
zh: 抱歉，我想我们没见过。不算真的见过……

#en: Oh, yeah. Haha. I know you, all right. How could I ever forget?
zh: 哦，是啊。哈哈。我当然认识你。我怎么可能忘得掉？

#en: What is this place, how'd we get here?
zh: 这是什么地方，我们怎么会到这儿？

#en: Are you okay? I was concerned.
zh: 你还好吗？我很担心。

#en: Be advised, unauthorized use of an artificial Astralgate is strictly prohibited. Please use Watchtower countermeasures responsibly.
zh: 特此告知，严禁未经授权使用人造星界之门。请负责任地使用瞭望塔反制手段。

#en: However, in order to achieve this, the Astralgate must be energized and imprinted with a suitable Deviant ability.
zh: 然而，为实现这一目的，星界之门必须充能，并印上合适的异常体能力。

#en: Please refrain from use of Deviant terminology. Deviant Countermeasure 05 -- the artificial Astralgate is capable of mass destruction.
zh: 请避免使用"异常体"这一措辞。异常体反制手段05——人造星界之门具备大规模杀伤能力。

#en: Augghhh... AHH! AHHHHH!!
zh: 啊啊啊……啊！啊啊啊啊！！

#en: Okay... Now or never!
zh: 好……就是现在！

#en: I can feel it! The resonance...
zh: 我能感觉到！那种共振……

#en: We did it. Off you go, get to your ship! Take that route over there! I'll be fine.
zh: 我们成功了。快走吧，回你的飞船去！走那边那条路！我没事。

#en: The interference has cleared. You can call down Skydrops again!
zh: 干扰已清除。你可以再次呼叫空投了！

#en: I'm gonna grab a ride back to Stardock with Gren. When you've got a moment, come find me. There's a few things I wanna say... Just, not yet.
zh: 我搭格伦的船回星坞。你有空的时候来找我。我有几件事想说……只是，现在还不行。

#en: If you could, please return to Stardock at your earliest convenience. There are topics we must discuss.
zh: 如果可以，请尽早返回星坞。有些话题我们必须谈谈。

#en: Docking sequence complete. You may now return to your vessel.
zh: 对接程序完成。你现在可以回到自己的飞船了。

#en: Please, board my vessel, and I will see you back to yours.
zh: 请上我的飞船，我送你回你的飞船。

#en: I managed to secure your ship and tow it to safety.
zh: 我设法固定住了你的飞船，把它拖到了安全地带。

#en: After what you have been through, that does not surprise me.
zh: 经历过这些之后，我并不意外。

#en: I think I want to leave here now.
zh: 我想我现在该离开这里了。

#en: Watchtower ran away?
zh: 瞭望塔跑了？

#en: After such a devastating loss, a tactical retreat was the most prudent response.
zh: 在遭受如此惨重的损失后，战术性撤退是最审慎的应对。

#en: If that's the terminology you prefer, then yes.
zh: 如果你喜欢这种说法，那就算是吧。

#en: You are welcome. I'm pleased I was able to assist.
zh: 不客气。我很高兴能帮上忙。

#en: Heimdall Station has been utterly destroyed. Any remaining Watchtower forces have retreated. I believe it's safe to say that you have won.
zh: 海姆达尔站已被彻底摧毁。任何残余的瞭望塔部队都已撤退。我认为可以放心地说，你赢了。

#en: Hm. That seems unlikely. But I suppose I must take you at your word.
zh: 嗯。这似乎不太可能。但我想我只能信你的话。

#en: I... I understand.
zh: 我……我明白。

#en: Torin took the easy way out.
zh: 托林选择了轻松的路。

#en: But... where is Torin?
zh: 可是……托林在哪？

#en: He sacrificed himself for me...
zh: 他为我牺牲了自己……

#en: You too, Torin.
zh: 你也是，托林。

#en: I'm sorry, he didn't make it.
zh: 抱歉，他没能挺过来。

#en: I see...
zh: 我明白了……

#en: Ah, Gren! You big softy! I knew you cared.
zh: 啊，格伦！你这个大软心肠！我就知道你在乎。

#en: I'm glad to see you safe and well.
zh: 很高兴看到你平安无事。

#en: Ah, and here comes Gren. Perfect. We could use a ride...
zh: 啊，格伦来了。正好。我们正好需要搭个顺风船……

#en: We did it! Heh. You did it.
zh: 我们做到了！嘿。是你做到的。

#en: Not sure if you saw it on your way down, but Heimdall -- is no more.
zh: 不知道你下来时看到没有，海姆达尔——已经不复存在了。

#en: Hey! Nice of you to make an appearance.
zh: 嘿！你可算露面了。

#en: It's certain to be a bumpy ride. Hold on tight! See you planetside.
zh: 这一路肯定很颠。抓稳了！行星表面见。

#en: I see Skydrops! Looks like we can use these.
zh: 我看到空投了！看来我们能用这些。

#en: Alright, you first! I'll be right behind you.
zh: 好，你先来！我紧随其后。

#en: Alright, you first! We'll be right behind you.
zh: 好，你先来！我们紧随其后。

#en: Okay, I was near the Armillary and then... I appeared here! Although, things looked a little darker. And you were here too! Only, it wasn't you.
zh: 好，我本来在浑天仪附近，然后……就出现在这里了！只不过，那里看起来暗一些。你也在这里！只不过，那不是你。

#en: Try to find a Skydrop bay. If you're lucky, there might be Skydrops for deploying troops. You can use one as an escape pod.
zh: 试着找一个空投舱。运气好的话，可能有用以投放部队的空投。你可以拿一个当逃生舱用。

#en: You'll need another way off the station.
zh: 你需要另想办法离开空间站。

#en: Could you give it a try? See if it works for you? Try something gravity-based.
zh: 你能试试吗？看看对你管不管用？试试重力类的。

#en: Well, that's not good! I can't seem to use my Starborn powers.
zh: 呃，这可不妙！我好像用不了我的星裔能力了。

#en: Huh...
You better hurry back to your ship.
zh: 你最好赶紧回你的飞船。

#en: Uh, I've got bad news. The station just lost its docking port... Your ship's adrift.
zh: 呃，我有坏消息。空间站刚失去了对接口……你的飞船漂走了。

#en: Clearly, you succeeded in triggering the self-destruct.
zh: 显然，你成功触发了自毁程序。

#en: I'm detecting multiple charges detonating across Heimdall Station, as well as several reactors going critical.
zh: 我侦测到多起爆炸在海姆达尔站各处引爆，还有几个反应堆正趋于临界。

#en: I don't know what you did, but it appears the station is going to collapse in on itself.
zh: 我不知道你做了什么，但看来这座空间站要自我坍塌了。

#en: I'm detecting increasing gravitational forces coming from within Heimdall Station.
zh: 我侦测到海姆达尔站内部传来的引力正在不断增强。

#en: Hey, on the side there, looks like there's a terminal to control the Armillary. You should do the honors! Activate it, and get ready to run.
zh: 嘿，旁边那儿好像有台控制浑天仪的终端。这份荣幸就交给你了！激活它，然后准备好跑路。

#en: And, looks like Armillary is good and energized! Guess I managed to imprint on it after all.
zh: 而且，浑天仪好像充能充足！看来我终究还是成功在它上面留下了印记。

#en: Huh. You know, I get the feeling if you hadn't come to get me, I may have been stuck in that place. Thanks! You're a good friend.
zh: 嗯。你知道吗，我感觉要是你没来接我，我可能就困在那个地方了。谢谢！你是个好朋友。

#en: Ah, we're back! Haha! And I could be wrong, but fairly sure I've got my powers back, too. Nice.
zh: 啊，我们回来了！哈哈！也许我弄错了，但我挺肯定我的能力也回来了。不错。

#en: After you! Back to Heimdall Station, and then we can put all this Watchtower nonsense to bed.
zh: 你先请！回海姆达尔站，然后我们就能把瞭望塔这堆烂事彻底了结。

#en: And, um, about that whole "bonding" thing? I think I might know what that was... but it can wait.
zh: 还有，呃，关于那个"羁绊"的事？我想我大概知道那是什么了……但可以等等再说。

#en: Hey, that did it! Good job!
zh: 嘿，成功了！干得好！

#en: Try a gravity-based power! That might do the trick.
zh: 试试重力类能力！也许能行。

#en: I'm guessing your guy made about as much sense as mine did. Which wasn't very much at all. Anyway...
zh: 我猜你那边的"人"说得跟我这边差不多没头没尾。反正也没说出什么。总之……

#en: I assume you... held hands as well? So... I guess that means we're bonded! We'll have to talk about that. But...
zh: 我猜你们也……牵手了？所以……那大概意味着我们建立了羁绊！这事我们得谈谈。不过……

#en: I'm gonna guess we didn't hold hands though, so no bonding for us! Oh well...
zh: 不过我猜我们没牵手，所以我们之间没有羁绊！唉……

#en: But there is a "Unity-like quality" to it all... But I can't really put my finger on it...
zh: 但这一切确实有种"像归一"的特质……可我又说不太清……

#en: No. No, I don't think so. Doesn't feel like it anyway.
zh: 不。不，我不这么认为。反正感觉不像。

#en: We can worry about that later. For now, let's figure a way outta here.
zh: 那个以后再说。眼下，我们先想办法离开这儿。

#en: Really? Now that is curious. You spoke to a me, and I spoke to a you...
zh: 真的？那就奇了。你跟一个"我"交谈，而我跟一个"你"交谈……

#en: Look, I'm really not sure what's going on right now. I can only assume all this is a side effect from the Watchtower Armillary...
zh: 听着，我现在真的不确定是怎么回事。我只能推测这一切是瞭望塔浑天仪的副作用……

#en: Look, is it just me, or are you getting strange "Unity vibes" from this place too? Maybe this is a side effect of Watchtower screwing around with Armillaries...
zh: 听着，是只有我这样，还是你也从这个地方感受到奇怪的"归一气息"？也许这是瞭望塔乱搞浑天仪的副作用……
